文件小 247 MiB、内存少 495 MiB，但没有更快；与 PyTorch: File 247 MiB smaller and memory 495 MiB lower, but not faster; agreement with PyTorch fell from 99.2% / 99.6% to 94.9% / 97.9%. The 1-point higher accuracy is quantization noise that happened to favor correct answers, not an improvement
文件小 1,383 MiB、内存少 2,767 MiB；工单准确率比 PyTor: File 1,383 MiB smaller and memory 2,767 MiB lower; support accuracy 0.6 points below PyTorch. Usable when 4B memory is tight
提交内存少 2,895 MiB，代价是工单慢 74%、助手慢 44%；准确率不变: Commit charge 2,895 MiB lower; the cost is 74% slower on support and 44% slower on assistant, accuracy unchanged. Inputs are only about 500 tokens, so most of the 8192 context was unused
GPU 更慢，进程工作集多 1,791 MiB，另占约 3,400 MiB 共享: The GPU is slower, the process working set is 1,791 MiB higher, about 3,400 MiB of shared GPU memory is used in addition, and agreement fell to 97.6% / 99.0%. Not the choice on this laptop
